gauge.name: Prairie Dog Town Fork of the Red River at Wayside

impacts.statement: Instruments are inudated by flood waters.
Highway 207 flooded. Highway bridge subject to flooding.
Highway 207 subject to flooding, just south of the highway bridge. Cattle in flood plain are threatened.
Cattle in flood plain will be threatened. Water will begin to touch underside of bridge
Dirt road along south side of river is flooded. Cattle in the flood plain are threatened.
Ranch and farm land within the flood plain begins to flood. Cattle in the flood plain are threatened
